%1$s; imvume yokuthi “Ukufinyelela ngokuphelele kwisitoreji” ayinikezwanga, izithombe zokuqala zigcinwe

Lolu hlelo ludinga ukufunda izithombe namavidiyo kudivayisi yakho:

• Imvume yezithombe: iskenja ialbamu ledivayisi, ibona izithombe ezinyakazayo kuyo
• Imvume yevidiyo: ithola ividiyo elihambisanayo lesithombe esinyakazayo samafayela amabili
• Imvume yendawo: igcina imetadata ye-GPS yendawo esithombeni (uma ingekho, imininingwane yendawo ilahleka emva kokuguqula)

Uma wenqaba, isikhethi esakhelwe ngaphakathi asisebenzi; ungaphinda uchofoze “Engeza amafayela” kamuva ukuze uphinde unikeze imvume.
Kudinga imvume yezithombe namavidiyo enikezwe ngesandla

Ngaphambilini wakhetha “Ungabuzi futhi”, ngakho isistimu ayiphindi ivule ibhokisi lemvume.

Hamba ku-“Ulwazi lohlelo” → Imvume → Izithombe namavidiyo, unikeze ngesandla imvume yokufinyelela bese ubuyela kulolu hlelo.

Qaphela: kufanele unikezwe ngesikhathi esisodwa imvume “Izithombe” ne-“Ividiyo”, uma kungenjalo, isithombe esinyakazayo samafayela amabili ngeke sithole ividiyo elihambisanayo salo.
Ukususa izithombe zokuqala kudinga “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”
Le divayisi ayisekeli ukususa ngokuzenzakalela izithombe zokuqala
Imodi yokubuyisela idinga “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”
Kundunyazwa ukuthi unikeze imvume yokuthi “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”

“Susa isithombe sokuqala emva kokucubungula” kususa ngqo amafayela okuqala kudiski (isithombe nevidiyo elihambisanayo salo); le nto ayibuyiseleki emuva, ngakho kuqala kufanele unikeze imvume yokuthi “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”.\n\nNgemva kokunikezwa imvume kuphela ishintshi esitholakala, ngesikhathi esizayo uyakwazi ukusivula ngokwezakho.

Isistimu yamanje (Android 10 nangaphansi) ayinikezi imvume yokuthi “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”, ngeke kususwe ngqo amafayela okuqala kudiski, ngakho le divayisi ayisekeli “Susa isithombe sokuqala emva kokucubungula”.\n\nEmva kokuguqula, ungahlanza izithombe zokuqala ngokwenza nge-albamu lesistimu.

Imodi yokubuyisela ibhala impumela yokuguqula ngqo phezu kwamafayela okuqala kudiski (ibhala phezu kokuqukethwe kokuqala); le nto ayibuyiseleki emuva, ngakho kuqala kufanele unikeze imvume yokuthi “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”.\n\nNgemva kokunikezwa imvume kuphela ishintshi esitholakala, ngesikhathi esizayo uyakwazi ukusivula ngokwezakho.

Isistimu yamanje (Android 10 nangaphansi) ayinikezi imvume yokuthi “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”, ngeke kubhalwa ngqo phezu kwamafayela okuqala kudiski, ngakho le divayisi ayisekeli imodi yokubuyisela.\n\nUngaqhubeka nokuguqula ngendlela ezenzakalelayo; impumela izokhishwa kifolda le-albamu.

Kwezinye izinhlobo zamadivayisi (njengeMeizu), ukubhala nge-API ye-albamu lesistimu kukhipha imininingwane yendawo ye-GPS, okudala ukuthi emva kokuguqula izithombe zilahlekelwe yindawo.

Ngemva kokunikezwa “Ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amafayela”, lolu hlelo luzobhala ngqo kifolda le-albamu, lugcine ngokuphelele imetadata yendawo.

Noma inganikezwanga, ukuguqula kusebenza kahle; kwezinye izinhlobo zamadivayisi imininingwane yendawo ingalahleka.
